source.question: Which wells need attention right now, and why?

note: Fair: detail numbers from evidence the finding does not cite (E16, E13, E14), undeclared 1.6%.

submission.summary: P-1 needs immediate attention with water cut at 90.3% and WOR of 9.31 at full choke, plus no downhole pressure data since 2018-04-10, while field injection is short after I-2 stopped with 2020 voidage replacement at 0.78. P-2 needs monitoring as water cut has risen to 31.2%.

findings.claim: P-1 needs immediate action: water cut is 90.3% with WOR 9.31 while choke has been at 100% since 2018-03.
findings.detail: Field screen 2020-12-31: P-1 oil_rate 145.97 Sm3/d, water_cut 0.903, level alarm (E1). Waterflood monthly: 2018-03 choke 100.0%, water_cut 0.8089, WOR 4.23; 2020-12 choke 100.0%, water_cut 0.903, WOR 9.31; wor_fit r2 0.75, log10_wor_per_million 1.23, remaining to WC 0.95 is 192412 Sm3 (E7). By_year liquid_rate 3086 (2017) -> 2976 (2018) -> 1822 (2020) Sm3/d at 100% choke (E7).

findings.claim: P-1 downhole pressure gauge has been dead since 2018-04-10, with 261,474 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data over 997 days.
findings.detail: Gauge failure 2018-04-10 to 2020-12-31: zero_days 997, flowing_days 972, oil_sm3_during 261474 Sm3, last good 240.2 bar on 2018-04-09 (E3). Field screen confirms dead_gauge alarm since 2018-04-10 (E1).

findings.claim: Field voidage is under-supported: I-2 has injected 0 Sm3/d since 2019-08-31 and 2020 replacement ratio is 0.78.
findings.detail: Field screen: I-2 cum 5053468 Sm3, water_inj 0.0 Sm3/d, issue stopped since 2019-08-31 (E1). Daily I-2 water_inj 0.0 on 2020-12-31 to 2020-12-12, I-1 3335-3530 Sm3/d (E17). Field_voidage 2020 injected 1175828, oil 614496, water 651111, replacement_ratio 0.7827, surface_ratio 0.9291 (E7).

findings.claim: P-2 needs watching: water cut is 31.2% in late 2020, up from 1.6% before, after oil rate dropped 74% around 2018-11-11.
findings.detail: Field screen water_cut 0.3118 (E1); monthly 2020-12 water_cut 0.3256, oil 9041 Sm3 at 295.93 Sm3/d (E16). Detect_events: oil_rate regime 2018-11-11 before_mean 1426 -> after_mean 368.95 (-74%, across 786.42 -> 463.29 -41%) (E4); water_cut regimes 2019-09-29 0.01588 -> 0.1299 and 2020-05-24 0.1299 -> 0.2721 (E4); threshold 0.05 on 2019-07-22 (E4). Fit_decline post-shift exponential qi 462.44, di 0.2203/yr, r2_log 0.8874, n 757, 2018-11-11 to 2020-12-31 (E20).

findings.claim: P-3 and P-4 are healthy now with water cuts of 1% and 2% and stable declines, needing no action.
findings.detail: Field screen: P-3 water_cut 0.01, oil 258.25 Sm3/d; P-4 water_cut 0.02, oil 795.49 Sm3/d, both level null (E1). Waterflood: P-3 water_cut 0.01 flat 2016-2020, P-4 0.02 flat, choke 55% and 60% (E9,E10). Fit_decline: P-3 hyperbolic qi 1803, di 0.5531/yr, b 0.3049, r2_log 0.9925 (E13); P-4 hyperbolic qi 1593, di 0.4813/yr, b 0.302, r2_log 0.9492 (E14).

issues.text: downhole pressure gauge reads 0 (997 days, 261,474 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data)

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.
